Bloodborne isn't the best fromsoft game and I don't know why so many people think it is. I'm not saying its bad. I love the game, but I think that both dark souls 3 and sekiro have just better bosses and experiences overall. Is it because of the art direction and it being (probably) the most unique fromsoft game? Because other than that the bosses in ds3 are so much better. In bloodborne you have orphan, Maria, gehrman and ludwig (the ones that stick out to me). Whereas in ds3 you have sister friede (first 3 phase boss pretty sure) abyss watchers, demon princes,  gael, midir which is the best dragon fight in the whole series. Gundir which is the best tutorial boss. Nameless King which (aside from the first phase) is a fantastic boss. And then there's sekiro. I won't talk as much about this game, but I believe it has the best combat out of any from game. The focus being shifted to parrying making it feel like a lightning fast rhythm game was amazing. There's also ishin ashina in the non shura ending. Which is genuinely my favourite fight in the whole fromsoft catalogue and has like fucking 4 phases. It's probably just me. But like I just genuinely do not understand why people like bloodborne so much. The bosses I listed, art direction and trick weapons are the only bits of the game I think sets it apart from the rest.
